name: logo-atelier
description: Human-in-the-loop logo design: brief-led references, layered SVG exploration, numbered choices, comment-driven finals and linked mockups.

interface.shortDescription: Agent 发散、设计师收敛：从需求到可编辑 Logo 与 mock。
interface.longDescription: Logo Atelier 1.0 将需求解析、每意象参考库、分层黑白初稿、几何与色材变体、编号/Comment 选择、终选迭代、mock 同步、平台导出与私有模版库组织成可追溯的设计流程。
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Logo Atelier 1.0. Read my brief and derive 2-3 visual intentions from product function, brand meaning and feeling/style; initial-letter exploration is optional. Reuse known answers, default to an iOS App icon, and ask at most 1-3 clarification rounds without usage-location questions. In my Figma file, collect about 30 relevant references per intention; let me select 2-3 per category by stable ID or Comment. Create layered monochrome roughs, backgrounds and applicable supporting motifs: 6-12 distinct directions with 2-3 representative combinations. Shortlist 2-3, then explore about 25 geometry variants per selected intention and about 25 color/material variants per selected shape, with separate background comparisons. Preserve taste rules, source provenance, independent editable layers and locked properties. Present short numbered choices after each round; unanswered ordinary preferences may proceed provisionally after a reasonable wait, but final approval is explicit. Refine through named final sections using complete comments, targeted references and controlled mixing, and synchronize mapped mockups in the same task. Reuse my product name and crisp system icons. Once I choose the final, verify platform and export destination, deliver checked SVG/PNG assets and save the approved design into the project or designated private template library. Local revisions do not restart the whole workflow.
